flags.observation: "Insiders, listen for" announces the dog whistles as a checklist; named openly they stop working as whistles and read like a syllabus.
Intro promises "twenty-two thirty-two", but the German Debt Clock line never sounds it; the insider cue goes unpaid.
"Paris wanted in." gives a city a want; a place acts like a person in an opener.
"to sustain illusion" drops the article; the clipped ending stumbles in one breath.
"just the illusion printers aren't running" loses its verb; "illusion printers" parses as a compound noun, meaning blurs.
"savior of the crisis" cuts the card's framing of him as hailed for fixing it; read literally, he saved the crisis itself.
"Union Banking Corp." keeps the abbreviation with a period; spoken delivery of "Corp." is ambiguous.
Callback "Schacht drew it up" relies on the BIS-commission link that beat 15 cut; listeners get no connection.
"for internationalization" is truncated; what gets internationalized stays unsaid, so the line ends without closure.
Card's institutional target was dropped; "Vultures love ruins" beside "war-torn nation" leaves the satire's aim unnamed near victims.
"no interest in dictated financial policy? Acquainted with harder arguments." two subjectless fragments; who is acquainted stays unclear.
The turn to the Vatican bank arrives without a bridge; bare "IOR" stays unexplained, normies cannot place it.
